description: This file defines a `QueueService` class responsible for managing a test execution queue. It provides methods to add, retrieve, remove, and complete queue items, interacting with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models.

classes.name: QueueService
classes.description: Service class that offers methods to manipulate and query the test execution queue, including adding, fetching, removing, and completing queue items.

methods.name: List[QueueItem] add_to_queue(self, db: Session, case_ids: List[str], user_id: str, priority: int = 0)
methods.description: Adds new test cases to the queue, avoiding duplicates, and returns the created queue items.

methods.name: List[QueueItem] get_queue(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Retrieves all queued items that are either queued or running, ordered by priority and queued time.

methods.name: QueueItem get_next_item(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Fetches the next test case to run from the queue, marking it as running and recording the start time.

methods.name: bool remove_from_queue(self, db: Session, case_id: str)
methods.description: Removes a specified test case from the queue by setting its status to cancelled.

methods.name: complete_queue_item(self, db: Session, item_id: str, run_id: str, success: bool)
methods.description: Marks a queue item as completed or failed, recording the run ID and completion time.

ctags.name: add_to_queue
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_to_queue(self, db: Session, case_ids: List[str], user_id: str, priority: int = 0) ->/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, case_ids: List[str], user_id: str, priority: int = 0)

ctags.name: complete_queue_item
ctags.pattern: /^    def complete_queue_item(self, db: Session, item_id: str, run_id: str, success: bool):$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, item_id: str, run_id: str, success: bool)

ctags.name: remove_from_queue
ctags.pattern: /^    def remove_from_queue(self, db: Session, case_id: str) -> bool:$/
